rites.name: Silemiel
rites.text: Silemiel is the concept of a quiet grove-power in Thonurde, understood in the Seeding as the hush that settles when the makers plant the Weave. Its acts are gentle: it binds soil, steadies roots, and calms the wind over growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Graiktak
rites.text: Graiktak is a concept of Thonurde's Holy Age, a force of flame and temple-bound oaths that rose after the Sundering broke the old worlds apart. Its adherents swore it into the Pact, binding the surviving orders to hold the Shards together.

rites.name: Karaithar
rites.text: Karaithar is a concept of Thonurde in the Walled Age, a notion of holding walls raised against the wild and kept by sworn orders. Its temples and first crossings, from the Holy Age of flame, shaped how the realm was guarded and how its people moved between districts.

rites.name: Telarum
rites.text: A way of perceiving in dim surroundings, achieved either through living senses or crafted devices. It works by combining a wide range of light wavelengths with a broad span of brightness levels.

rites.name: Tarnadath
rites.text: Tarnadath is a grounded concept in the Thonurde omniverse, a loose coalition of valley militias that pooled their salvaged engines and wired tools into one fighting force. Its doctrine favors small, mobile crews who avoid open ground and strike from hidden ridgelines.

rites.name: Bredanar
rites.text: Bredanar is a grounded concept, a covert formation of thirty-odd operatives trained to hunt hidden enemies of a nation's leadership. Its members work from a quiet hangar carved beneath a frozen harbor, where they rehearse silent entries and sudden extractions. The unit is rarely acknowledged, and its name is spoken only by those who have seen its work.
